kvendra-cloud.description: Kvendra hosted KB engine. 20 MCP tools (entity_*, txn_*, whoami, config_get, help, export, check_notifications, raise_dispute, resolve_dispute, approve_proposal, reject_proposal). Auth: OAuth 2.1 + PKCE against auth.kvendra.cloud (Cognito Hosted UI). Pro tier required — see https://kvendra.ai. Server name is `kvendra-cloud` (not `kvendra`) to avoid colliding with the local `kvendra` CLI MCP server — Claude Code resolves same-name servers by scope precedence and Local > Plugin, so a same-name plugin server gets eclipsed silently.
